group_distribution: Experiment One: 59 participants; Experiment Two: 93 participants
primary_objective: To investigate if participant sex and experimenter sex influence placebo analgesia and subjective and physiological stress.
group_comparison: Experiment One: Placebo condition (PC) vs Natural History Condition (NHC); Experiment Two: Placebo group (PG) vs Cream-Control group (CCG) vs Pain-Control group (PCG)
